description: Self-managed Couchbase Server content bleeds into the Capella cloud/eventing/ tree in multiple places, distinct from the already-known server-version-string anomaly (this is about product/UI naming, not version numbers). eventing-function-export.md names 'Couchbase Web Console' where Capella pages should say 'Capella UI'. eventing-examples-docexpiry.md and eventing-examples-delete-v-expiry.md reference self-managed-only tooling (cbc CLI paths, 'Couchbase Server' phrasing) not applicable to Capella. Same likely root cause as the version-string and edition-badge anomalies already logged: server/ content adapted into cloud/ without full review.
